# Noto Sans TC PDF renderer test subset

- Source file: `NotoSansTC[wght].ttf`
- Upstream SHA-256 at fixture creation: `864727d210d54f2537bbe23b3a839436c3992af72de9322af5270897246bd44f`
- Subset SHA-256: `dd73c02f35be7d56dc01b7d3d31bf6f498d89393cc5238c670f3a1e41b9a29f0`

The base64-encoded subset is test-only and contains ASCII plus the Traditional
Chinese glyphs required by the synthetic document-rendering fixture. Production
documents must use a separately approved, private template font asset whose
SHA-256 is frozen with the template version.
